title: WorkloadUnit - Data API
description: Represents the number of work items and average handle time in a specific time interval. This object is available in API version 49.0 and later.

AverageHandleTime.description: The average handle time at a specific period of time.

CustomWorkType.description: The derived field of WorkDemographic.CustomWorkType for the custom dimension value.

DateTime.description: The timestamp of the single data point in the time series of the workload.

IsOmni.properties: Defaulted on create, Filter, Group, Sort
IsOmni.description: Derived from isOmni field in workload. Indicates that the workload is Omni-based The default value is 'false'.

MeasureUnit.properties: Defaulted on create, Filter, Group, Nillable, Restricted picklist, Sort
MeasureUnit.description: The time interval (in minutes) used in the workload. Possible values are: 43200—Monthly. Reserved for future use. 10080—Weekly 1440—Daily 60—Hourly 30—30 minutes. Reserved for future use. 15—15 minutes. Reserved for future use. The default value is '1440'.

Region.description: The derived field from WorkDemographic.Region for the region value.

SkillSet.description: The derived field from WorkDemographic.SkillSet for the skill value.

TotalCount.description: The total number work items at a specific period of time.

WorkDemographicId.description: The foreign key to the WorkDemographic object. This is a relationship field.

WorkloadId.description: The foreign key to the Workload object. This is a relationship field.

WorkloadType.properties: Defaulted on create, Filter, Group, Nillable, Restricted picklist, Sort
WorkloadType.description: The derived field from Workload.WorkloadType to indicate the type of workload, for example, a history or forecast workload. Possible values are: F—Forecasted H—Historical The default value is 'H'.
